releases.summaryKey: Offline help, guided tour, and an in-app changelog.

itemKeys: Searchable offline Help in German and English.
A safe interactive tour for planning, approval, staging, and undo.
A complete version history inside Settings.
A clickable version and build summary in the main window.
The Help window no longer restores over the main window after relaunch.

releases.summaryKey: German and English throughout the complete app.

itemKeys: Immediate language switching between System Default, English, and German.
An extensible localization manifest for future languages.
OpenAI proposal reasons follow the selected interface language without changing cleanup data.

releases.summaryKey: A clean signed update target for end-to-end updater validation.

itemKeys: Published a clean signed update target for updater verification.

releases.summaryKey: Reliable Sparkle installation in the macOS sandbox.

itemKeys: Sandboxed installations can launch Sparkle's required installer service.
Release validation rejects archives missing the required Sparkle configuration.
Checksum files now contain portable asset names instead of local build paths.

releases.summaryKey: Signed manual and optional automatic updates.

itemKeys: Manual update checks in Settings and the application menu.
Optional automatic checks against the signed public stable feed.

releases.summaryKey: Advanced review, rules, diagnostics, and update readiness.

itemKeys: Source depth, age, exclusion, duplicate, and session-retention controls.
Multi-selection review, exact AI request preview, rules, and redacted diagnostics.
Persistent plans, configurable filename styles, and explicit session finalization.
Duplicate hashes remain local and diagnostics structurally exclude private file data.

releases.summaryKey: The first complete safe Desktop Cleaner release.

itemKeys: Native onboarding, read-only scanning, reviewable plans, and deterministic organization.
Transactional staging, durable journals, recovery, and complete session undo.
Optional metadata-only OpenAI proposals with a Keychain-stored user API key.
A signed, notarized universal macOS app with a dedicated premium icon.
Sensitive files stay outside AI batches and model output cannot control destructive actions.
